title: Single-Server Queueing Process
description: Minimal SIMSCRIPT II.5 discrete-event queueing model with an inline PREAMBLE, FIFO waiting set, single-unit server resource, and exponential interarrivals.
code:
'' MODEL: SingleServerQueue
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY CUSTOMER BELONGS TO WAIT.LINE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE ARRIVAL.GEN
    INCLUDE CUSTOMER
  RESOURCES
    EVERY CLERK
  DEFINE WAIT.LINE AS A FIFO SET
  ACCUMULATE AVG.BUSY AS THE MEAN OF N.X.CLERK
  ACCUMULATE AVG.QUEUE AS THE MEAN OF N.Q.CLERK
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY CLERK(1)
  LET U.CLERK = 1
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.GEN NOW
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS ARRIVAL.GEN
  ACTIVATE A CUSTOMER NOW
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.GEN IN EXPONENTIAL.F(5.0, 1) MINUTES
END

PROCESS CUSTOMER
  FILE THIS CUSTOMER IN WAIT.LINE
  REQUEST 1 CLERK
  REMOVE FIRST CUSTOMER FROM WAIT.LINE
  WORK EXPONENTIAL.F(4.0, 2) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 CLERK
  DESTROY THIS CUSTOMER
END

title: Parallel Machine Repair Shop with Breakdowns
description: Industrial maintenance shop with multiple repair technicians servicing stochastic machine failures using Erlang repair durations and resource utilization accumulation.
code:
'' MODEL: MachineRepairShop
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY FAILED.UNIT HAS A SEVERITY AND BELONGS TO REPAIR.QUEUE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE FAILURE.GEN
    INCLUDE FAILED.UNIT
  RESOURCES
    EVERY TECHNICIAN
  DEFINE REPAIR.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE DOWN.TIME AS A REAL VARIABLE
  TALLY MEAN.DOWNTIME AS THE MEAN OF DOWN.TIME
  ACCUMULATE TECH.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.TECHNICIAN
  ACCUMULATE BACKLOG AS THE MEAN OF N.Q.TECHNICIAN
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY TECHNICIAN(1)
  LET U.TECHNICIAN = 3
  ACTIVATE A FAILURE.GEN NOW
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS FAILURE.GEN
  ACTIVATE A FAILED.UNIT NOW
  ACTIVATE A FAILURE.GEN IN EXPONENTIAL.F(3.5, 1) HOURS
END

PROCESS FAILED.UNIT
  FILE THIS FAILED.UNIT IN REPAIR.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 TECHNICIAN
  REMOVE FIRST FAILED.UNIT FROM REPAIR.QUEUE
  WORK ERLANG.F(6.0, 2, 2) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 TECHNICIAN
  DESTROY THIS FAILED.UNIT
END

title: Hospital Triage Priority Queue with TALLY and ACCUMULATE
description: Emergency department triage workflow with ranked priority set ordering, physician and trauma bed resources, and declared TALLY and ACCUMULATE statistics.
code:
'' MODEL: HospitalTriageCenter
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY PATIENT HAS AN ACUITY AND BELONGS TO TRIAGE.SET
  PERMANENT ENTITIES
    EVERY HOSPITAL OWNS A TRIAGE.SET
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE PATIENT.ARRIVALS
    INCLUDE PATIENT
  RESOURCES
    EVERY PHYSICIAN
    EVERY TRAUMA.BED
  EVENT NOTICES
    INCLUDE SHIFT.CHANGE
  DEFINE TRIAGE.SET AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE WAIT.TIME AS A REAL VARIABLE
  DEFINE TREATMENT.TIME AS A REAL VARIABLE
  DEFINE TOTAL.SEEN AS AN INTEGER VARIABLE
  TALLY MEAN.WAIT AS THE MEAN OF WAIT.TIME
  TALLY MAX.TREAT AS THE MAXIMUM OF TREATMENT.TIME
  ACCUMULATE BUSY.DOCS AS THE MEAN OF N.X.PHYSICIAN
  ACCUMULATE BUSY.BEDS AS THE MEAN OF N.X.TRAUMA.BED
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY PHYSICIAN(1)
  CREATE EVERY TRAUMA.BED(1)
  LET U.PHYSICIAN = 4
  LET U.TRAUMA.BED = 8
  ACTIVATE A PATIENT.ARRIVALS NOW
  SCHEDULE A SHIFT.CHANGE IN 8.0 HOURS
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS PATIENT.ARRIVALS
  ACTIVATE A PATIENT NOW
  ACTIVATE A PATIENT.ARRIVALS IN EXPONENTIAL.F(12.0, 1) MINUTES
END

PROCESS PATIENT
  FILE THIS PATIENT IN TRIAGE.SET
  REQUEST 1 TRAUMA.BED
  REQUEST 1 PHYSICIAN
  REMOVE FIRST PATIENT FROM TRIAGE.SET
  WORK NORMAL.F(28.0, 6.0, 2) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 PHYSICIAN
  RELINQUISH 1 TRAUMA.BED
  DESTROY THIS PATIENT
END

EVENT SHIFT.CHANGE
  PRINT PHYSICIAN SHIFT HANDOVER COMPLETE
END

title: Air Traffic Runway Arrival and Departure Scheduler
description: Multi-file SIMSCRIPT II.5 airport runway operations model coordinating landing and takeoff aircraft queues, shared runway wake-turbulence separation, and weather visibility shifts.
code:
'' MODEL: AirTrafficRunwayScheduler
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY ARRIVAL.FLIGHT HAS A WAKE.CLASS AND BELONGS TO HOLDING.STACK
    EVERY DEPART.FLIGHT HAS A GATE.ID AND BELONGS TO TAXIWAY.QUEUE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE ARRIVAL.STREAM
    INCLUDE DEPART.STREAM
    INCLUDE ARRIVAL.FLIGHT
    INCLUDE DEPART.FLIGHT
  RESOURCES
    EVERY RUNWAY
    EVERY TERMINAL.GATE
  EVENT NOTICES
    INCLUDE WEATHER.UPDATE
  DEFINE HOLDING.STACK AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE TAXIWAY.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE HOLDING.DELAY AS A REAL VARIABLE
  DEFINE TAXI.DELAY AS A REAL VARIABLE
  TALLY AVG.HOLD.DELAY AS THE MEAN OF HOLDING.DELAY
  TALLY AVG.TAXI.DELAY AS THE MEAN OF TAXI.DELAY
  ACCUMULATE RUNWAY.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.RUNWAY
  ACCUMULATE GATE.OCCUPANCY AS THE MEAN OF N.X.TERMINAL.GATE
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY RUNWAY(1)
  CREATE EVERY TERMINAL.GATE(1)
  LET U.RUNWAY = 2
  LET U.TERMINAL.GATE = 12
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.STREAM NOW
  ACTIVATE A DEPART.STREAM NOW
  SCHEDULE A WEATHER.UPDATE IN 6.0 HOURS
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS ARRIVAL.STREAM
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.FLIGHT NOW
  ACTIVATE AN ARRIVAL.STREAM IN EXPONENTIAL.F(4.5, 1) MINUTES
END

PROCESS DEPART.STREAM
  ACTIVATE A DEPART.FLIGHT NOW
  ACTIVATE A DEPART.STREAM IN EXPONENTIAL.F(5.0, 2) MINUTES
END

PROCESS ARRIVAL.FLIGHT
  FILE THIS ARRIVAL.FLIGHT IN HOLDING.STACK
  REQUEST 1 RUNWAY
  REMOVE FIRST ARRIVAL.FLIGHT FROM HOLDING.STACK
  WORK UNIFORM.F(1.5, 2.5, 3) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 RUNWAY
  REQUEST 1 TERMINAL.GATE
  WORK NORMAL.F(35.0, 8.0, 4) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 TERMINAL.GATE
  DESTROY THIS ARRIVAL.FLIGHT
END

PROCESS DEPART.FLIGHT
  FILE THIS DEPART.FLIGHT IN TAXIWAY.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 RUNWAY
  REMOVE FIRST DEPART.FLIGHT FROM TAXIWAY.QUEUE
  WORK UNIFORM.F(1.2, 2.0, 5) MINUTES
  RELINQUISH 1 RUNWAY
  DESTROY THIS DEPART.FLIGHT
END

EVENT WEATHER.UPDATE
  PRINT RUNWAY VISIBILITY CONDITIONS UPDATED
END

title: Multi-Echelon Logistics Supply Chain Network
description: Multi-file SIMSCRIPT II.5 three-echelon freight distribution network coordinating factory dispatch, regional cross-dock sorting, fleet truck allocation, and periodic inventory audits.
code:
'' MODEL: MultiEchelonSupplyChain
PREAMBLE
  TEMPORARY ENTITIES
    EVERY SHIPMENT HAS A WEIGHT AND BELONGS TO DISPATCH.QUEUE
    EVERY REPLENISH.ORDER HAS A SKU.CODE AND BELONGS TO DOCK.QUEUE
  PERMANENT ENTITIES
    EVERY DISTRIBUTION.HUB OWNS A DISPATCH.QUEUE
  PROCESSES
    INCLUDE ORDER.GENERATOR
    INCLUDE SHIPMENT
    INCLUDE REPLENISH.ORDER
  RESOURCES
    EVERY LINEHAUL.TRUCK
    EVERY CROSSDOCK.BAY
    EVERY LOCAL.VAN
  EVENT NOTICES
    INCLUDE INVENTORY.AUDIT
  DEFINE DISPATCH.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE DOCK.QUEUE AS A FIFO SET
  DEFINE LEAD.TIME AS A REAL VARIABLE
  DEFINE DOCK.WAIT AS A REAL VARIABLE
  TALLY MEAN.LEAD.TIME AS THE MEAN OF LEAD.TIME
  TALLY MEAN.DOCK.WAIT AS THE MEAN OF DOCK.WAIT
  ACCUMULATE TRUCK.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.LINEHAUL.TRUCK
  ACCUMULATE BAY.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.CROSSDOCK.BAY
  ACCUMULATE VAN.UTIL AS THE MEAN OF N.X.LOCAL.VAN
END

MAIN
  CREATE EVERY LINEHAUL.TRUCK(1)
  CREATE EVERY CROSSDOCK.BAY(1)
  CREATE EVERY LOCAL.VAN(1)
  LET U.LINEHAUL.TRUCK = 6
  LET U.CROSSDOCK.BAY = 4
  LET U.LOCAL.VAN = 10
  ACTIVATE AN ORDER.GENERATOR NOW
  SCHEDULE AN INVENTORY.AUDIT IN 24.0 HOURS
  START SIMULATION
END

PROCESS ORDER.GENERATOR
  ACTIVATE A SHIPMENT NOW
  ACTIVATE A REPLENISH.ORDER IN EXPONENTIAL.F(3.0, 1) HOURS
  ACTIVATE AN ORDER.GENERATOR IN EXPONENTIAL.F(1.5, 2) HOURS
END

PROCESS SHIPMENT
  FILE THIS SHIPMENT IN DISPATCH.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 LINEHAUL.TRUCK
  REMOVE FIRST SHIPMENT FROM DISPATCH.QUEUE
  WORK NORMAL.F(4.5, 0.8, 3) HOURS
  REQUEST 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  WORK UNIFORM.F(0.8, 1.5, 4) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 LINEHAUL.TRUCK
  REQUEST 1 LOCAL.VAN
  RELINQUISH 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  WORK EXPONENTIAL.F(1.2, 5) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 LOCAL.VAN
  DESTROY THIS SHIPMENT
END

PROCESS REPLENISH.ORDER
  FILE THIS REPLENISH.ORDER IN DOCK.QUEUE
  REQUEST 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  REMOVE FIRST REPLENISH.ORDER FROM DOCK.QUEUE
  WORK UNIFORM.F(0.5, 1.0, 6) HOURS
  RELINQUISH 1 CROSSDOCK.BAY
  DESTROY THIS REPLENISH.ORDER
END

EVENT INVENTORY.AUDIT
  PRINT DAILY MULTI-ECHELON INVENTORY AUDIT COMPLETE
END
